_note: Two groups. clients[] = enterprise work delivered at RapidData (client-named, prose hand-authored, NO internal hostnames, no public links). tools[] = open-source side projects, each linking to its GitHub repo; live facts come from data/_generated/github.json. collection + publication are supporting facts surfaced in the Credentials section.

clients.name: Employee Hub
clients.oneLiner: An HR platform shipped to the App Store and Play Store. Built the Apple Wallet and Google Wallet employee passes in Java, push notifications, and managed the certificates and provisioning profiles behind the release.

clients.name: Legal Document System
clients.oneLiner: A multi-level approval workflow with an in-browser document editor and annotation, built on the Apryse (PDFTron) document SDK.

clients.name: Governance Platform
clients.oneLiner: An internal enterprise application supporting legal and governance workflows for a Dubai government entity.

clients.name: Enterprise Mobile App
clients.oneLiner: An enterprise mobile application taken end to end, from the Mendix native build through to store deployment.

clients.name: API Integration Layer
clients.oneLiner: Designed, secured and deployed API proxies and Application Integration flows on Google Cloud, connecting Jira, Oracle Fusion and Microsoft Graph.

tools.name: WidgetForge
tools.oneLiner: Describe a Mendix widget in plain English and it generates the TSX, XML and a deployable package — with multi-provider AI, BYOK, and live build logs.

tools.name: mxtest-cli
tools.oneLiner: Zero-config CLI to build, run and end-to-end test Mendix apps using Docker and Playwright.

tools.name: mcp-redmine-rd
tools.oneLiner: An MCP server that pulls tracker tickets — screenshots included as viewable images — into an AI coding agent, plus a skill that carries an issue from ticket to verified fix.

tools.name: react-native-airfob
tools.oneLiner: BLE tap-and-go access credentials behind one JavaScript API, with native modules in Kotlin and Swift and a working mock so the chain runs before the SDK licence lands.

tools.name: rapid-reporter
tools.oneLiner: A one-click bug-report browser extension that captures screenshot, console, network and DOM state into a developer-ready ticket. MIT-licensed.

tools.name: ECO-Bot
tools.oneLiner: An IoT-powered automated tractor for land analysis, ploughing and irrigation — peer-reviewed and published in IEEE Xplore.

collection.name: Mendix widget library
